import base64
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
import pathlib
import subprocess
import time

ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
FIXTURE = ROOT / 'minimal-cache-diagnosis' / 'fixture-1'
RESULT = ROOT / 'commands' / 'd07-minimal-cache-probe.json'
assert not RESULT.exists()
FIXTURE.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
(FIXTURE / 'src').mkdir()
(FIXTURE / 'Cargo.toml').write_text(
    '[package]\nname = "wi1087-cache-probe"\nversion = "0.1.0"\nedition = "2021"\n'
)
(FIXTURE / 'src/lib.rs').write_text(
    '#[test] fn manifest_path() { println!("MANIFEST_PATH={}", env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")); }\n'
)
target_digest = hashlib.sha256(os.fsencode(str(FIXTURE.resolve()))).hexdigest()
default_target = pathlib.Path.home() / '.cache/ai-cockpit-verify-target' / target_digest
control_target = ROOT / 'minimal-cache-diagnosis' / 'control-target-1'
env = os.environ.copy()
env.update({
    'PATH': '/workspace/.cloud-tools/cargo/bin:' + env['PATH'],
    'CARGO_HOME': '/workspace/.cloud-tools/cargo',
    'RUSTUP_HOME': '/workspace/.cloud-tools/rustup',
    'CARGO_INCREMENTAL': '0',
    'CARGO_BUILD_JOBS': '1',
    'CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG': '0',
    'RUST_TEST_THREADS': '1',
    'RUST_TEST_NOCAPTURE': '1',
    'CARGO_TARGET_X86_64_UNKNOWN_LINUX_GNU_RUNNER':
        'bash /workspace/ai-cockpit/tests/ci/run_process_observer_test_runner.sh',
})
report = {
    'kind': 'isolated_no_dependency_cargo_cache_diagnosis_not_formal_verification',
    'fixture': str(FIXTURE), 'homeUnchanged': env.get('HOME'),
    'defaultTargetMatchesNativeFallbackFormula': str(default_target),
    'defaultCacheRootExistedBefore': default_target.parent.exists(),
    'controlTarget': str(control_target),
    'nodeBudgetSeconds': 600, 'commands': [],
    'sourceHead': subprocess.check_output(
        ['git', '-C', '/workspace/ai-cockpit', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True
    ).strip(),
    'fixtureSourceHashes': {
        str(p.relative_to(FIXTURE)): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        for p in [FIXTURE / 'Cargo.toml', FIXTURE / 'src/lib.rs']
    },
    'meaning': 'The workspace-target control is diagnostic only and cannot replace the failed native fixture or workspace receipt.',
}

def run(label, args, target):
    child_env = env.copy()
    child_env['CARGO_TARGET_DIR'] = str(target)
    cmd = ['timeout', '--signal=TERM', '--kill-after=10s', '590s',
           '/workspace/.cloud-tools/cargo/bin/cargo', *args]
    started = time.monotonic()
    item = {'label': label, 'command': cmd, 'cwd': str(FIXTURE),
            'cargoTargetDir': str(target),
            'startedAt': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()}
    completed = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=FIXTURE, env=child_env, capture_output=True)
    item.update({'exitCode': completed.returncode,
                 'elapsedSeconds': round(time.monotonic() - started, 3),
                 'endedAt': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()})
    for stream in ['stdout', 'stderr']:
        data = getattr(completed, stream)
        (ROOT / 'commands' / f'd07-{label}.{stream}').write_bytes(data)
        item[stream] = {'encoding': 'base64', 'bytes': len(data),
                        'rawSha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),
                        'data': base64.b64encode(data).decode()}
    report['commands'].append(item)
    RESULT.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(json.dumps({k: item[k] for k in ['label', 'exitCode', 'elapsedSeconds', 'cargoTargetDir']}))
    for stream in ['stdout', 'stderr']:
        text = getattr(completed, stream).decode(errors='replace')
        if text:
            print(stream + ':\n' + text)
    return completed.returncode

if run('lockfile', ['generate-lockfile', '--offline'], control_target) != 0:
    raise SystemExit('Lockfile generation failed; no test invoked.')
failed = run('default-cache', ['test', '--offline', '--locked', '--', '--nocapture'], default_target)
if failed:
    run('workspace-control', ['test', '--offline', '--locked', '--', '--nocapture'], control_target)
report['defaultCacheRootExistsAfter'] = default_target.parent.exists()
RESULT.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
